get.description:
Returns a feed of events for your organization, newest first: failed
installs, connection lifecycle changes, sync activity, and schedule state
changes. Narrow the feed with the integration, connection, customer, event
type, and time filters. A start_date is required.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Only return requests received at or after this time. Cannot be more than 14 days ago, which is how long we retain logs.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Only return requests received at or before this time. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: connection_id
parameters.description: Only return requests made against this connection.

parameters.name: integration_name
parameters.description: Only return requests made against connections to this integration. The same name can exist across types, so pair it with `integration_type` to disambiguate.

parameters.name: integration_type
parameters.description: Only return requests made against connections of this integration type.

parameters.name: request_method
parameters.description: Only return requests made with this HTTP method.

parameters.name: request_path
parameters.description: Only return requests made to this endpoint. Path parameters are replaced with `<path_param>`, so a request to `/wms/orders/123` is stored as `/wms/orders/<path_param>`.

parameters.name: status_code
parameters.description: Only return requests that returned this HTTP status code.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of requests to return per page. The default is 100. Minimum 1 and maximum 5000. Fewer may be returned if the page would be too large, in which case a `next_token` is included.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: The page token to use to retrieve the next page of results. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

parameters.name: x-trackstar-api-key
parameters.description: Your organization-level Trackstar API key.

get.description: Returns the API requests your organization made to Trackstar, most recent first. Filter by connection, integration, date range, request path, method, or status.

parameters.name: x-trackstar-api-key
parameters.description: Your organization-level Trackstar API key.

parameters.name: x-trackstar-access-token
parameters.description: Your user's access token for a specific integration (ShipHero, Extensiv, etc).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key that makes this request safe to retry. Send the same key on a retry and Trackstar returns the first attempt's response instead of writing again; if the first attempt failed, the retry runs the write again. Reusing a key with a different request is rejected. Keys expire after 24 hours.

post.description: Get the required, optional, and integration specific fields by calling the [integrations](/api-reference/mgmt/integrations) endpoint.

parameters.name: x-trackstar-api-key
parameters.description: Your organization-level Trackstar API key.

parameters.name: x-trackstar-access-token
parameters.description: Your user's access token for a specific integration (ShipHero, Extensiv, etc).

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: The page token to use to retrieve the next page of results. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return. The default is 1000.

parameters.name: created_date
parameters.description:
Use this parameter to retrieve items filtered to a specific date range. For example, to get all items between 2023-03-10 and 2023-03-22, you would send `created_date[gte]=2023-03-10T00:00:00Z&created_date[lte]=2023-03-22T00:00:00Z.` See the [filtering docs](/how-to-guides/about-the-api#filtering) for more. The date format must always be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. 
 Note: it is much more efficient to use a combination of `gte`/`lte` than it is to use `gt`/`lt`.

parameters.name: updated_date
parameters.description: Same syntax as `created_date`.

parameters.name: trackstar_created_date
parameters.description: Same syntax as `created_date`.

parameters.name: trackstar_updated_date
parameters.description: Same syntax as `created_date`.

parameters.name: trackstar_tags
parameters.description:
Filter by trackstar tags. Dict-shaped tags should be queried as "key:value" strings. 
 This filter is not indexed. Pair it with an indexed filter (`updated_date`, `created_date`, `trackstar_updated_date`, `trackstar_created_date`) using eq, gt, gte, lt or lte for faster, fuller pages. See [filtering docs](/how-to-guides/about-the-api#filtering).

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description:
The SKU of the item. 
 This filter is not indexed. Pair it with an indexed filter (`updated_date`, `created_date`, `trackstar_updated_date`, `trackstar_created_date`) using eq, gt, gte, lt or lte for faster, fuller pages. See [filtering docs](/how-to-guides/about-the-api#filtering).

updated_date.description: The date the purchase order was last updated.

reference_id.description: An external reference on the order, such as the supplier's quote number. Null if the ERP has no external reference.

status.description: The status of the purchase order. See the [purchase order information](info) for more details.

raw_status.description: The raw status label returned directly from the ERP (e.g., 'Pending Receipt', 'Partially Received').

order_date.description: The date the purchase order was placed or booked in the ERP.

expected_arrival_date.description: The expected or promised receipt date for the order.

vendor_id.description: ID of the vendor in the ERP.

employee_id.description: ID of the internal employee (requestor / buyer) on the order. Optional on writes; passed through to the ERP when provided. When omitted, the ERP's own enforcement applies — accounts that require an employee will reject the request.

location_id.description: ID of the ERP location the order will be received into, when set at the order level.

total_price.description: Grand total the supplier will be paid for the order (item subtotal plus tax and shipping minus discount), in the order currency.

notes.description: List of free-form notes recorded on the order.

line_items.description: List of line items on the purchase order.

custom_fields.description: Per-account custom fields defined on the purchase order. Keys are the field names as defined in the ERP; each value carries the raw value, its declared type, and a human-readable label.
